name: social-ad
about: A 15 s social ad on a white page, every seam hidden inside a motion: the opener built word by word (the name landing oversized and defocused, each new word in the accent at the line's end, the line re-centring) and breathing apart through the cut onto a pile of pictures, the mark spinning in over a picture that pulls back, a wall of pictures settling tile by tile round the claim and its accent pill, two rivers of pictures under a label that recedes and swaps its last word, two taglines over the hero picture, the lockup. new-film.sh --template social-ad lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every ad is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): a driving track whose downbeats carry the act lines and whose hits the pops, spins and rushes ride; earshot effects mark what lands; never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 140-160 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track); 140-160 BPM (or a half-time 70-80) with clear hits suits one bar an act
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --template social-ad --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end stop|button|ring
